## Collections & Product Categories
### Women's Wear
- Festive Party Wear & Embellished Lehengas
- 3-Piece Co-ord Ethnic Suit Sets with Dupatta
- Embroidered Kurtis (Cotton, Rayon, Silk)
- Ethnic & Western Dresses
- Casual Tops & Tunics
- Stretch Leggings & Ankle Length Pants
- Modest Abaya & Burqa Collection

### Kids' Wear
- Girls' Festive & Party Wear
- Flared Birthday Frocks
- Boys' Kurta Pyjama & Sherwani Sets
- Boys' Shirts & Trousers
- Coordinated 2-Piece and 3-Piece Kids' Sets
